findings: Prepare unpacks unvalidated sources before protected handling and lacks a rooted raw-sources field.
Terminal outcome and reentry-return semantics were ambiguous; exact-False reservation required.
Read/audit limits used relaxed ranges instead of accepted exact values; float validity needed precision.
Context binding validation was after lifecycle instead of before delegation.
Manifest exact key list omitted launcher; metadata latch coherence not explicit.
Envelope input snapshots, caps and nonce bindings needed exact contract.
Phase-A errors were described as unreachable; fake seam injection does not measure OOM.
Numeric/canonical parser rules and selected-source versus execution-closure scope needed precision.
